engines.name: Qwen 1.7B
engines.description: Like Qwen 0.6B but sounds better. For strong NVIDIA graphics cards with about 5 GB of free VRAM next to the game.

engines.name: Qwen 0.6B
engines.description: Closest match to the reference voice. Needs an NVIDIA graphics card (AMD with ROCm is experimental) and about 4 GB of free VRAM next to the game; keeps the GPU busy while it speaks.

engines.name: Pocket TTS
engines.description: Runs on the processor, so your graphics card stays with the game, and sounds clearly better than MOSS. One model per language (no Japanese); needs a reasonably fast CPU.
